brief: A box with a lid for the plasters and bandages in my first-aid kit.

requirements.requirement: Box to hold plasters and bandages

requirements.evidence: cover:0,0,0;full;top + handle:0,0,0;top (lid with grab handle); box closed with caps, check_build clear
Two compartments (~68x124mm each, ~75mm deep); no plaster/bandage props exist in find_props, and closed lid hides interior so no staging props added
requirements.requirement: Suitable for first-aid kit plasters and bandages, dressed for purpose

finish.summary: Single-cell lidded box: divided bin gives two compartments for plasters vs bandages, solid top cover with handle as the lid, capped and locked. No exact plaster/bandage props exist so interior left empty.
